Unless cancelled at least 24 h before the end of the current period, the subscription renews automatically at the same price. Manage or cancel anytime in your account's subscription settings (App Store / Google Play). Monthly plans are commitment-free; the « lifetime » purchase is a one-time, non-recurring payment.
